title: Milan and Lake Como
speaker: Rick Steves' Europe
zh: 【Rick Steves' Europe】米蘭和科莫湖（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hi, I'm Rick Steves, back with more of the best of Europe.
cues.en: Hi, I'm Rick Steves, back with more of the best of Europe.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是裡克·史蒂夫斯，我帶著更多歐洲最好的作品回來了。

cues.text: This time, we're in north Italy, enjoying the lofty and inspiring heights of Milano.
cues.en: This time, we're in north Italy, enjoying the lofty and inspiring heights of Milano.
cues.zh: 這一次，我們來到了義大利北部，欣賞米蘭的崇高和鼓舞人心的高度。

cues.text: Thanks for joining us.
cues.en: Thanks for joining us.
cues.zh: 感謝您加入我們。

cues.text: Many tourists come to Italy because of its past.
cues.en: Many tourists come to Italy because of its past.
cues.zh: 許多遊客來到義大利是因為它的過去。

cues.text: But Milano is today's Italy, and no Italian trip is complete without visiting this city.
cues.en: But Milano is today's Italy, and no Italian trip is complete without visiting this city.
cues.zh: 但米蘭就是今天的義大利，如果不參觀這座城市，義大利之旅就不完整。

cues.text: While overlooked by many, Milano has plenty to see and is a joy to visit.
cues.en: While overlooked by many, Milano has plenty to see and is a joy to visit.
cues.zh: 雖然米蘭被許多人忽視，但它有很多值得一看的地方，而且遊覽起來很愉快。

cues.text: In Milano, we'll soar on the rooftop of one of Europe's grandest Gothic cathedrals,
cues.en: In Milano, we'll soar on the rooftop of one of Europe's grandest Gothic cathedrals,
cues.zh: 在米蘭，我們將翱翔在歐洲最宏偉的哥德式大教堂之一的屋頂上，

cues.text: window-shop in Milan's fashionable neighborhoods, visit the world's most famous Opera house,
cues.en: window-shop in Milan's fashionable neighborhoods, visit the world's most famous Opera house,
cues.zh: 在米蘭的時尚街區逛逛櫥窗，參觀世界上最著名的歌劇院，

cues.text: and admire a Leonardo masterpiece before relaxing in the 19th-century charm of Lake Como.
cues.en: and admire a Leonardo masterpiece before relaxing in the 19th-century charm of Lake Como.
cues.zh: 欣賞達芬奇的傑作，然後在科莫湖的 19 世紀魅力中放鬆身心。

cues.text: Italy hosts millions of visitors every year, but many miss the highlights of the north.
cues.en: Italy hosts millions of visitors every year, but many miss the highlights of the north.
cues.zh: 義大利每年接待數百萬遊客，但許多人錯過了北部的亮點。

cues.text: In this program, we tour Milano and side trip into the Lake District,
cues.en: In this program, we tour Milano and side trip into the Lake District,
cues.zh: 在這個節目中，我們遊覽米蘭並順便遊覽湖區，

cues.text: exploring my favorite -- Lake Como -- specifically, the towns of Varenna and Bellagio.
cues.en: exploring my favorite -- Lake Como -- specifically, the towns of Varenna and Bellagio.
cues.zh: 探索我最喜歡的——科莫湖——特別是瓦倫納和貝拉吉奧鎮。

cues.text: They say, for every church in Rome, there's a bank in Milan.
cues.en: They say, for every church in Rome, there's a bank in Milan.
cues.zh: 他們說，羅馬有一座教堂，米蘭就有一家銀​​行。

cues.text: Italy's second city, and the capital of the region of Lombardy, Milano is a hardworking, fashion-conscious,
cues.en: Italy's second city, and the capital of the region of Lombardy, Milano is a hardworking, fashion-conscious,
cues.zh: 米蘭是義大利的第二大城市，也是倫巴第大區的首府，是個勤奮、時尚、

cues.text: time-is-money city of nearly a million and a half.
cues.en: time-is-money city of nearly a million and a half.
cues.zh: 時間就是金錢的城市，擁有近百萬人口。

cues.text: And the city is a fascinating melting pot of people and history.
cues.en: And the city is a fascinating melting pot of people and history.
cues.zh: 這座城市是一個令人著迷的人文和歷史的熔爐。

cues.text: Italy recently surpassed Britain in per capita income, and that didn't happen because of its cute Riviera ports
cues.en: Italy recently surpassed Britain in per capita income, and that didn't happen because of its cute Riviera ports
cues.zh: 義大利最近在人均收入方面超過了英國，但這並沒有發生，因為它可愛的裡維埃拉港口

cues.text: and Tuscan hilltowns.
cues.en: and Tuscan hilltowns.
cues.zh: 和托斯卡納山城。

cues.text: The economic success of modern Italy is driven by this city of publicists and pasta power lunches.
cues.en: The economic success of modern Italy is driven by this city of publicists and pasta power lunches.
cues.zh: 現代義大利的經濟成功是由這座城市的公關人員和麵食午餐推動的。

cues.text: Milan is Italy's industrial, banking, publishing, and convention capital.
cues.en: Milan is Italy's industrial, banking, publishing, and convention capital.
cues.zh: 米蘭是義大利的工業、銀行、出版和會議之都。

cues.text: As if making up for its blocky architecture, its people are works of art.
cues.en: As if making up for its blocky architecture, its people are works of art.
cues.zh: 彷彿彌補了其塊狀建築的不足，這裡的人們都是藝術品。

cues.text: Milan is an international fashion center with a refined taste.
cues.en: Milan is an international fashion center with a refined taste.
cues.zh: 米蘭是國際時尚中心，品味高雅。

cues.text: Window displays are gorgeous.
cues.en: Window displays are gorgeous.
cues.zh: 櫥窗展示很華麗。

cues.text: Yet, thankfully, Milan is no more expensive for tourists than other Italian cities.
cues.en: Yet, thankfully, Milan is no more expensive for tourists than other Italian cities.
cues.zh: 然而，值得慶幸的是，米蘭對遊客來說並不比其他義大利城市貴。

cues.text: The importance of Milano is nothing new.
cues.en: The importance of Milano is nothing new.
cues.zh: 米蘭的重要性並不新鮮。

cues.text: Three hundred years before Christ, the Romans called this place Mediolanum,
cues.en: Three hundred years before Christ, the Romans called this place Mediolanum,
cues.zh: 在基督誕生前三百年，羅馬人稱這個地方為Mediolanum，

cues.text: or "the central place." By the 4th century AD, it was the capital of the western half of the Roman Empire.
cues.en: or "the central place." By the 4th century AD, it was the capital of the western half of the Roman Empire.
cues.zh: 或“中心地點”。到公元4世紀，它已成為羅馬帝國西半部的首都。

cues.text: It was from here that Emperor Constantine issued the Edict of Milan,
cues.en: It was from here that Emperor Constantine issued the Edict of Milan,
cues.zh: 康斯坦丁皇帝正是從這裡頒布了米蘭法令，

cues.text: which legalized Christianity in the year 313.
cues.en: which legalized Christianity in the year 313.
cues.zh: 313年使基督教合法化。

cues.text: After struggling through the early Middle Ages, Milan rose to prominence
cues.en: After struggling through the early Middle Ages, Milan rose to prominence
cues.zh: 在經歷了中世紀早期的掙扎後，米蘭崛起

cues.text: under the powerful Visconti and Sforza families.
cues.en: under the powerful Visconti and Sforza families.
cues.zh: 在強大的維斯康提和斯福爾扎家族的統治下。

cues.text: By the time of the Renaissance, the city was called "the new Athens"
cues.en: By the time of the Renaissance, the city was called "the new Athens"
cues.zh: 到文藝復興時期，這座城市被稱為“新雅典”

cues.text: and was enough of a cultural center for Leonardo da Vinci to call home.
cues.en: and was enough of a cultural center for Leonardo da Vinci to call home.
cues.zh: 足以成為達文西稱之為家的文化中心。

cues.text: And then came four centuries of foreign domination -- Spain, Austria, France, and more Austria.
cues.en: And then came four centuries of foreign domination -- Spain, Austria, France, and more Austria.
cues.zh: 然後是四個世紀的外國統治——西班牙、奧地利、法國，還有更多的奧地利。

cues.text: In the 19th century, Milano became a center of revolution
cues.en: In the 19th century, Milano became a center of revolution
cues.zh: 19世紀，米蘭成為革命中心

cues.text: against Austrian rule, and then it helped spearhead the movement for Italian independence and unification.
cues.en: against Austrian rule, and then it helped spearhead the movement for Italian independence and unification.
cues.zh: 反對奧地利統治，然後幫助領導了義大利獨立和統一運動。

cues.text: In the 20th century, Mussolini left a heavy fascist touch on Milan's architecture.
cues.en: In the 20th century, Mussolini left a heavy fascist touch on Milan's architecture.
cues.zh: 20世紀，墨索里尼為米蘭的建築留下了濃厚的法西斯色彩。

cues.text: Il Duce himself made grandiose speeches from these balconies.
cues.en: Il Duce himself made grandiose speeches from these balconies.
cues.zh: 領袖本人就在這些陽臺上發表了宏偉的演講。

cues.text: And Milan's immense train station thunders fascism.
cues.en: And Milan's immense train station thunders fascism.
cues.zh: 米蘭巨大的火車站震懾著法西斯主義。

cues.text: Every time I pass through, I imagine the rush the fascists must have felt on the day in 1931
cues.en: Every time I pass through, I imagine the rush the fascists must have felt on the day in 1931
cues.zh: 每次我經過這裡，我都會想像法西斯主義者在 1931 年的那一天一定感受到的衝擊

cues.text: when the grand renovations of this station were unveiled.
cues.en: when the grand renovations of this station were unveiled.
cues.zh: 當這個車站的宏偉改造揭幕時。

cues.text: It's designed to make you feel small, too small to question Mussolini
cues.en: It's designed to make you feel small, too small to question Mussolini
cues.zh: 它的目的是讓你感覺自己很渺小，渺小到無法質疑墨索里尼

cues.text: and his government's right wing agenda.
cues.en: and his government's right wing agenda.
cues.zh: 以及他的政府的右翼議程。

cues.text: Mussolini's excesses led to the bombing of Milan in World War II.
cues.en: Mussolini's excesses led to the bombing of Milan in World War II.
cues.zh: 墨索里尼的暴行導致了第二次世界大戰中米蘭的轟炸。

cues.text: But Milan rose again.
cues.en: But Milan rose again.
cues.zh: 但米蘭再次崛起。

cues.text: The 1959 Pirelli Tower was a trendsetter.
cues.en: The 1959 Pirelli Tower was a trendsetter.
cues.zh: 1959 年的倍耐力大樓 (Pirelli Tower) 引領了潮流。

cues.text: Today, Milan is dynamic and a commercial powerhouse.
cues.en: Today, Milan is dynamic and a commercial powerhouse.
cues.zh: 如今，米蘭充滿活力，是個商業強國。

cues.text: The city's centerpiece is its magnificent Duomo, or cathedral -- the fourth-largest in Europe.
cues.en: The city's centerpiece is its magnificent Duomo, or cathedral -- the fourth-largest in Europe.
cues.zh: 這座城市的中心是宏偉的大教堂－歐洲第四大教堂。

cues.text: Back in the 14th century, when Europe was fragmented into countless little independent states,
cues.en: Back in the 14th century, when Europe was fragmented into countless little independent states,
cues.zh: 早在14世紀，當歐洲分裂成無數獨立的小國時，

cues.text: the dukes of Milan wanted to impress their German and French counterparts.
cues.en: the dukes of Milan wanted to impress their German and French counterparts.
cues.zh: 米蘭公爵想要給德國和法國同行留下深刻的印象。

cues.text: To earn their respect, they built this huge and richly ornamented cathedral.
cues.en: To earn their respect, they built this huge and richly ornamented cathedral.
cues.zh: 為了贏得他們的尊重，他們建造了這座巨大且裝飾華麗的大教堂。

cues.text: Even though the Renaissance style, with its domes and rounded arches, was in vogue elsewhere in Italy,
cues.en: Even though the Renaissance style, with its domes and rounded arches, was in vogue elsewhere in Italy,
cues.zh: 儘管帶有圓頂和圓形拱門的文藝復興風格在義大利其他地方很流行，

cues.text: conservative Milano stuck with the Gothic style.
cues.en: conservative Milano stuck with the Gothic style.
cues.zh: 保守的米蘭堅持哥德式風格。

cues.text: The dukes, thinking Northerners could relate better to Gothic, loaded it with pointed spires and arches.
cues.en: The dukes, thinking Northerners could relate better to Gothic, loaded it with pointed spires and arches.
cues.zh: 公爵們認為北方人更容易接受哥德式建築，因此在哥德式建築上安裝了尖頂和拱門。

cues.text: And everything's made of marble.
cues.en: And everything's made of marble.
cues.zh: 一切都是大理石製成的。

cues.text: The statues on the tips of the many spires seem so relaxed,
cues.en: The statues on the tips of the many spires seem so relaxed,
cues.zh: 眾多尖塔尖上的雕像顯得如此輕鬆，

cues.text: like they're just hanging out, waiting for their big day.
cues.en: like they're just hanging out, waiting for their big day.
cues.zh: 就像他們只是閒逛，等待他們的大日子。

cues.text: The fanciful gargoyles, functioning as drain spouts, are especially imaginative.
cues.en: The fanciful gargoyles, functioning as drain spouts, are especially imaginative.
cues.zh: 奇特的石像鬼，充當排水管，特別有想像。

cues.text: The church is a good example of the flamboyant, or "flamelike," overdone final stage of Gothic.
cues.en: The church is a good example of the flamboyant, or "flamelike," overdone final stage of Gothic.
cues.zh: 這座教堂是哥德式風格最後階段華麗或「火焰般」過度的一個很好的例子。

cues.text: Step inside, and you're struck by the immensity of the place.
cues.en: Step inside, and you're struck by the immensity of the place.
cues.zh: 走進去，你就會被這個地方的廣闊震撼。

cues.text: The soaring ceiling is supported by sequoia-sized pillars.
cues.en: The soaring ceiling is supported by sequoia-sized pillars.
cues.zh: 高聳的天花板由紅杉大小的柱子支撐。

cues.text: Started in 1386 and not finished until 1810,
cues.en: Started in 1386 and not finished until 1810,
cues.zh: 1386年開始，直到1810年才完成，

cues.text: this construction project originated the phrase Italians use to say "never-ending":
cues.en: this construction project originated the phrase Italians use to say "never-ending":
cues.zh: 這個建設專案起源於義大利人所說的「永無止境」：

cues.text: "like building a cathedral." Much of the brilliantly colored stained glass
cues.en: "like building a cathedral." Much of the brilliantly colored stained glass
cues.zh: 「就像建造一座大教堂。」大部分色彩鮮豔的彩色玻璃

cues.text: dates from about 1500.
cues.en: dates from about 1500.
cues.zh: 其歷史可追溯至約 1500 年。

cues.text: So does the fine inlaid marble floor.
cues.en: So does the fine inlaid marble floor.
cues.zh: 精美鑲嵌的大理石地板也是。

cues.text: After 500 years of wear, you can tell that the black marble is harder than the rest.
cues.en: After 500 years of wear, you can tell that the black marble is harder than the rest.
cues.zh: 經過 500 年的磨損，您可以看出黑色大理石比其他大理石更硬。

cues.text: A grotesque 16th-century statue of St. Bartolomeo, a martyr skinned alive by the Romans,
cues.en: A grotesque 16th-century statue of St. Bartolomeo, a martyr skinned alive by the Romans,
cues.zh: 一座 16 世紀的聖巴爾託洛梅奧 (St. Bartolomeo) 雕像，他是一位被羅馬人活剝皮的烈士，

cues.text: wears his skin like a robe.
cues.en: wears his skin like a robe.
cues.zh: 他的皮膚就像一件長袍。

cues.text: You can actually see his limp feet and dangling face.
cues.en: You can actually see his limp feet and dangling face.
cues.zh: 你實際上可以看到他無力的雙腳和晃來晃去的臉。

cues.text: It was sculpted by a student of Leonardo, who obviously picked up
cues.en: It was sculpted by a student of Leonardo, who obviously picked up
cues.zh: 它是由列奧納多的一名學生雕刻的，他顯然學到了

cues.text: his master's passion for the human anatomy.
cues.en: his master's passion for the human anatomy.
cues.zh: 他的老師對人體解剖學的熱情。

cues.text: Cap your visit with a trip to the rooftop.
cues.en: Cap your visit with a trip to the rooftop.
cues.zh: 以屋頂之旅結束您的訪問。

cues.text: Walking through its forest of pinnacles and statues, you enjoy great views of the church's statuary,
cues.en: Walking through its forest of pinnacles and statues, you enjoy great views of the church's statuary,
cues.zh: 漫步在尖塔和雕像的森林中，您可以欣賞到教堂雕像的美景，

cues.text: as well as of the city.
cues.en: as well as of the city.
cues.zh: 以及城市的。

cues.text: And, crowning the cathedral, a golden Virgin Mary overlooks everything.
cues.en: And, crowning the cathedral, a golden Virgin Mary overlooks everything.
cues.zh: 在大教堂的頂上，一尊金色的聖母瑪利亞俯視著一切。

cues.text: "La Madonnina," as she's affectionately called, is an icon of Milano.
cues.en: "La Madonnina," as she's affectionately called, is an icon of Milano.
cues.zh: 她被親切地稱為“La Madonnina”，是米蘭的象徵。

cues.text: Milan's main square is a classic European scene
cues.en: Milan's main square is a classic European scene
cues.zh: 米蘭的主廣場是經典的歐洲場景

cues.text: and a popular local gathering point.
cues.en: and a popular local gathering point.
cues.zh: 和一個受歡迎的當地聚集點。

cues.text: The statue features Victor Emmanuel II, first king of Italy.
cues.en: The statue features Victor Emmanuel II, first king of Italy.
cues.zh: 這座雕像的主角是義大利第一位國王維克託·伊曼紐二世。

cues.text: He's looking at the grand gallery named for him.
cues.en: He's looking at the grand gallery named for him.
cues.zh: 他正在看著以他命名的大畫廊。

cues.text: The words above the triumphal arch entrance read: "To Victor Emmanuel II, from the people of Milano."
cues.en: The words above the triumphal arch entrance read: "To Victor Emmanuel II, from the people of Milano."
cues.zh: 凱旋門入口上方寫著：“米蘭人民致維克託·伊曼紐爾二世。”

cues.text: The Galleria Vittorio Emanuele is the pride of the city.
cues.en: The Galleria Vittorio Emanuele is the pride of the city.
cues.zh: 維托里奧埃馬努埃萊長廊是這座城市的驕傲。

cues.text: Built during the heady days of Italian unification, around 1870, it was the first building in town
cues.en: Built during the heady days of Italian unification, around 1870, it was the first building in town
cues.zh: 它建於 1870 年左右義大利統一的鼎盛時期，是鎮上的第一座建築

cues.text: to have electric lighting.
cues.en: to have electric lighting.
cues.zh: 有電照明。

cues.text: Its art celebrates the establishment of Italy as an independent country.
cues.en: Its art celebrates the establishment of Italy as an independent country.
cues.zh: 它的藝術慶祝義大利作為一個獨立國家的建立。

cues.text: Around the central dome, mosaics symbolize the four major continents.
cues.en: Around the central dome, mosaics symbolize the four major continents.
cues.zh: 中央穹頂周圍的馬賽克圖案象徵著四大洲。

cues.text: The mosaic floor is also patriotic.
cues.en: The mosaic floor is also patriotic.
cues.zh: 馬賽克地板也很愛國。

cues.text: The She-wolf with Romulus and Remus honors Rome, the national capital.
cues.en: The She-wolf with Romulus and Remus honors Rome, the national capital.
cues.zh: 母狼與羅慕路斯和雷穆斯向國家首都羅馬致敬。

cues.text: A favorite is the torino, or "little bull." While it represents the city of Torino,
cues.en: A favorite is the torino, or "little bull." While it represents the city of Torino,
cues.zh: 最喜歡的是都靈，或「小公牛」。雖然它代表了都靈市，

cues.text: for locals, it's a source of good luck.
cues.en: for locals, it's a source of good luck.
cues.zh: 對當地人來說，這是好運的泉源。

cues.text: They can't resist stepping on his little testicles.
cues.en: They can't resist stepping on his little testicles.
cues.zh: 他們忍不住踩著他的小睪丸。

cues.text: Locals claim it works better if you give it a spin.
cues.en: Locals claim it works better if you give it a spin.
cues.zh: 當地人聲稱，如果你嘗試一下，效果會更好。

cues.text: Milan's immense Sforza Castle tells the story of the city in brick.
cues.en: Milan's immense Sforza Castle tells the story of the city in brick.
cues.zh: 米蘭巨大的斯福爾扎城堡用磚塊講述了這座城市的故事。

cues.text: It guarded the gate to the city wall and defended the ruling family
cues.en: It guarded the gate to the city wall and defended the ruling family
cues.zh: 它守護著城牆的大門，保衛著統治家族

cues.text: from threats both foreign and domestic.
cues.en: from threats both foreign and domestic.
cues.zh: 免受國內外威脅。

cues.text: In the 1500s, the entire city was circled by state-of-the-art walls,
cues.en: In the 1500s, the entire city was circled by state-of-the-art walls,
cues.zh: 在1500年代，整個城市被最先進的城牆包圍，

cues.text: of which this castle was a key element.
cues.en: of which this castle was a key element.
cues.zh: 這座城堡是其中的關鍵元素。

cues.text: It's apparent from the enormity of this fortification that Milano was a strategic prize.

cues.text: While the town walls are long gone, this massive castle survives, leaving the city
cues.en: While the town walls are long gone, this massive castle survives, leaving the city

cues.text: with an inviting and well-used public space.

cues.text: Locals and tourists alike enjoy strolling its expansive grounds.
cues.en: Locals and tourists alike enjoy strolling its expansive grounds.
cues.zh: 當地人和遊客都喜歡在廣闊的土地上漫步。

cues.text: A short tram ride takes you to a different kind of public place --

cues.zh: 搭乘短程電車即可帶您前往不同型別的公共場所—

cues.text: Milan's Monumental Cemetery.

cues.zh: 米蘭紀念公墓。

cues.text: While there are many evocative cemeteries in Europe, this one -- with its emotional portrayals
cues.en: While there are many evocative cemeteries in Europe, this one -- with its emotional portrayals
cues.zh: 雖然歐洲有許多令人回味的墓地，但這個墓地充滿了情感描寫

cues.text: of the departed and their heavenly escorts -- in the melodramatic art styles
cues.en: of the departed and their heavenly escorts -- in the melodramatic art styles
cues.zh: 逝者與他們的天堂護衛－以情節劇的藝術風格

cues.text: from the late 19th and early 20th centuries -- is in a class by itself.
cues.en: from the late 19th and early 20th centuries -- is in a class by itself.
cues.zh: 19世紀末20世紀初－自成一類。

cues.text: It's a vast garden art gallery of proud busts and grim reapers,
cues.en: It's a vast garden art gallery of proud busts and grim reapers,
cues.zh: 這是一座巨大的花園藝術畫廊，裡面有驕傲的半身像和死神，

cues.text: heartbroken angels and weeping widows.
cues.en: heartbroken angels and weeping widows.
cues.zh: 傷心欲絕的天使和哭泣的寡婦。

cues.text: Soldiers too young to die.
cues.en: Soldiers too young to die.
cues.zh: 士兵太年輕，不能死。

cues.text: Acres of grief, hope, and memories.
cues.en: Acres of grief, hope, and memories.
cues.zh: 充滿悲傷、希望和回憶。

cues.text: The grand, pedestrianized Via Dante leads from the Sforza Castle
cues.en: The grand, pedestrianized Via Dante leads from the Sforza Castle
cues.zh: 宏偉的但丁步行街從斯福爾扎城堡延伸出來

cues.text: toward the town center and the cathedral.
cues.en: toward the town center and the cathedral.
cues.zh: 朝向市中心和大教堂。

cues.text: It was carved out of a medieval tangle of streets to celebrate Italian unification.
cues.en: It was carved out of a medieval tangle of streets to celebrate Italian unification.
cues.zh: 它是在中世紀混亂的街道上雕刻而成的，以慶祝義大利的統一。

cues.text: Because of that, the facades lining it are relatively new -- dating from the late 1800s.
cues.en: Because of that, the facades lining it are relatively new -- dating from the late 1800s.
cues.zh: 正因為如此，它的外牆相對較新——可以追溯到 1800 年代末。

cues.text: Over the vigorous complaints of merchants, the street became traffic-free in 1995.
cues.en: Over the vigorous complaints of merchants, the street became traffic-free in 1995.
cues.zh: 在商家的強烈投訴下，這條街於1995年禁止車輛通行。

cues.text: Today, those merchants would have it no other way.
cues.en: Today, those merchants would have it no other way.
cues.zh: 如今，那些商人別無他法。

cues.text: Fashionistas love Milan's world-class shopping zone, a neighborhood called the Quadrilateral.
cues.en: Fashionistas love Milan's world-class shopping zone, a neighborhood called the Quadrilateral.
cues.zh: 時尚達人喜愛米蘭的世界級購物區，名為「四邊形」的街區。

cues.text: This elegant high-fashion district was the original Beverly Hills of Milan.
cues.en: This elegant high-fashion district was the original Beverly Hills of Milan.
cues.zh: 這個優雅的高階時裝區是最初的米蘭比佛利山莊。

cues.text: Overseeing the shopping action are the exclusive and elusive penthouse apartments
cues.en: Overseeing the shopping action are the exclusive and elusive penthouse apartments
cues.zh: 獨特而難以捉摸的頂層公寓監督著購物活動

cues.text: with their plush roof gardens.
cues.en: with their plush roof gardens.
cues.zh: 及其豪華的屋頂花園。

cues.text: Since the 1920s, this has been the place for designer labels.
cues.en: Since the 1920s, this has been the place for designer labels.
cues.zh: 自 1920 年代以來，這裡一直是設計師品牌的聚集地。

cues.text: In this scene, the people-watching is as entertaining as the window-shopping.
cues.en: In this scene, the people-watching is as entertaining as the window-shopping.
cues.zh: 在這個場景中，觀看行人就像逛街一樣有趣。

cues.text: For edible fashion, check out one of Milan's gourmet delis like Peck.
cues.en: For edible fashion, check out one of Milan's gourmet delis like Peck.
cues.zh: 若想品嚐時尚美食，不妨前往 Peck 等米蘭的美食熟食店之一。

cues.text: If ever you wanted to have a picnic meal and not save money, buy it here.
cues.en: If ever you wanted to have a picnic meal and not save money, buy it here.
cues.zh: 如果您想野餐但又不想省錢，請在這裡購買。

cues.text: Everything's impeccable, from the staff to the lavish displays.
cues.en: Everything's impeccable, from the staff to the lavish displays.
cues.zh: 從工作人員到奢華的展示，一切都無可挑剔。

cues.text: The busy kitchen is like a gourmet assembly line.
cues.en: The busy kitchen is like a gourmet assembly line.
cues.zh: 忙碌的廚房就像一條美食流水線。

cues.text: Posh markets like this serve fine food to both Milan's busy professionals
cues.en: Posh markets like this serve fine food to both Milan's busy professionals
cues.zh: 像這樣的豪華市場為米蘭忙碌的專業人士提供美味佳餚

cues.text: and its well-to-do.
cues.en: and its well-to-do.
cues.zh: 以及它的富裕。

cues.text: And if you're spending half your budget on a picnic, you might as well ride the elevator into the cellar
cues.en: And if you're spending half your budget on a picnic, you might as well ride the elevator into the cellar
cues.zh: 如果你把一半的預算花在野餐上，不妨搭電梯進入地窖

cues.text: for a bottle of wine to match.
cues.en: for a bottle of wine to match.
cues.zh: 來一瓶與之相配的葡萄酒。

cues.text: Catering to people with good taste and more money than time,
cues.en: Catering to people with good taste and more money than time,
cues.zh: 迎合有品味、金錢比時間多的人，

cues.text: places like this put an elegant twist on fast food.
cues.en: places like this put an elegant twist on fast food.
cues.zh: 像這樣的地方為快餐增添了優雅的氣息。

cues.text: 500 years ago, Leonardo da Vinci contributed to the city's reputation for design and aesthetics.
cues.en: 500 years ago, Leonardo da Vinci contributed to the city's reputation for design and aesthetics.
cues.zh: 500 年前，達文西 (Leonardo da Vinci) 為這座城市的設計和美學聲譽做出了貢獻。

cues.text: In fact, Leonardo's identified with Milan more than any other Italian city.
cues.en: In fact, Leonardo's identified with Milan more than any other Italian city.
cues.zh: 事實上，李奧納多對米蘭的認同感超過了其他義大利城市。

cues.text: This is where he spent some of his most productive years, enjoying the generous patronage of the Sforza family.
cues.en: This is where he spent some of his most productive years, enjoying the generous patronage of the Sforza family.
cues.zh: 他在這裡度過了他最富有成效的歲月，享受了斯福爾扎家族的慷慨贊助。

cues.text: Leonardo was the epitome of a Renaissance genius.
cues.en: Leonardo was the epitome of a Renaissance genius.
cues.zh: 列奧納多是文藝復興時期天才的縮影。

cues.text: That means he was well-rounded -- he was a painter and sculptor.
cues.en: That means he was well-rounded -- he was a painter and sculptor.
cues.zh: 這意味著他是一位多才多藝的人——他是一位畫家和雕塑家。

cues.text: He was also a musician, scientist, engineer, architect -- you name it.
cues.en: He was also a musician, scientist, engineer, architect -- you name it.
cues.zh: 他還是一位音樂家、科學家、工程師、建築師──凡是你能想到的。

cues.text: He did everything, and he did it well.
cues.en: He did everything, and he did it well.
cues.zh: 他什麼都做了，而且做得很好。

cues.text: This statue celebrates the many ways Leonardo contributed to the city of Milan
cues.en: This statue celebrates the many ways Leonardo contributed to the city of Milan
cues.zh: 這座雕像慶祝了萊昂納多對米蘭市做出的多種貢獻

cues.text: during the years he lived here.
cues.en: during the years he lived here.
cues.zh: 他住在這裡的那些年。

cues.text: The reliefs recall Leonardo's varied professional triumphs.
cues.en: The reliefs recall Leonardo's varied professional triumphs.
cues.zh: 這些浮雕讓人回想起李奧納多的各種職業成就。

cues.text: Leonardo, wearing his hydroengineer hat here, re-engineered Milan's canal system, complete with locks.
cues.en: Leonardo, wearing his hydroengineer hat here, re-engineered Milan's canal system, complete with locks.
cues.zh: 萊昂納多在這裡戴著水利工程師的帽子，重新設計了米蘭的運河系統，並安裝了船閘。

cues.text: Until the 1920s, Milan was one of Italy's major ports,
cues.en: Until the 1920s, Milan was one of Italy's major ports,
cues.zh: 直到 1920 年代，米蘭一直是義大利的主要港口之一，

cues.text: with canals connecting the city to the Po river and to the Mediterranean beyond.
cues.en: with canals connecting the city to the Po river and to the Mediterranean beyond.
cues.zh: 運河將城市與波河和遠處的地中海連線起來。

cues.text: And Leonardo designed the largest equestrian monument in the world,
cues.en: And Leonardo designed the largest equestrian monument in the world,
cues.zh: 萊昂納多設計了世界上最大的馬術紀念碑，

cues.text: again, for the Sforza family.
cues.en: again, for the Sforza family.
cues.zh: 再次，為斯福爾扎家族。

cues.text: Though the original was destroyed in 1499 by invading French troops who used it for target practice,
cues.en: Though the original was destroyed in 1499 by invading French troops who used it for target practice,
cues.zh: 儘管原件於 1499 年被入侵的法國軍隊摧毀，當時法國軍隊將其用於打靶練習，

cues.text: the giant horse was rebuilt in 1999 by the American artist Charles Dent,
cues.en: the giant horse was rebuilt in 1999 by the American artist Charles Dent,
cues.zh: 這匹巨馬由美國藝術家查爾斯·登特於1999年重建，

cues.text: from Leonardo's drawings.
cues.en: from Leonardo's drawings.
cues.zh: 出自列奧納多的畫作。

cues.text: One of Leonardo's greatest masterpieces decorates the monks' dining hall
cues.en: One of Leonardo's greatest masterpieces decorates the monks' dining hall
cues.zh: 達文西最偉大的傑作之一裝飾了僧侶的餐廳

cues.text: adjacent the Church of Santa Maria delle Grazie.
cues.en: adjacent the Church of Santa Maria delle Grazie.
cues.zh: 毗鄰聖瑪麗亞感恩教堂。

cues.text: Admission to the "Last Supper" is by reservation only, and spots can be booked up well over a month in advance.
cues.en: Admission to the "Last Supper" is by reservation only, and spots can be booked up well over a month in advance.
cues.zh: 「最後的晚餐」的門票必須提前預訂，並且可以提前一個多月預訂。

cues.text: Good guidebooks explain the process.
cues.en: Good guidebooks explain the process.
cues.zh: 好的指南會解釋這個過程。

cues.text: Because of the fragility of this much-loved Renaissance masterpiece, the humidity is carefully regulated.
cues.en: Because of the fragility of this much-loved Renaissance masterpiece, the humidity is carefully regulated.
cues.zh: 由於這深受喜愛的文藝復興傑作的脆弱性，濕度需要經過精心調節。

cues.text: We're enjoying a private visit with our TV camera.
cues.en: We're enjoying a private visit with our TV camera.
cues.zh: 我們正在用電視攝影機進行私人訪問。

cues.text: But normally, groups of 25 are allowed in every 15 minutes,
cues.en: But normally, groups of 25 are allowed in every 15 minutes,
cues.zh: 但正常情況下，每15分鐘允許25人一組，

cues.text: only after dehumidifying in this waiting chamber.
cues.en: only after dehumidifying in this waiting chamber.
cues.zh: 只有在候診室除濕後。

cues.text: Seeing the "Last Supper," one of the greatest works in art history, is well worth the hassle.
cues.en: Seeing the "Last Supper," one of the greatest works in art history, is well worth the hassle.
cues.zh: 觀看藝術史上最偉大的作品之一《最後的晚餐》是非常值得的。

cues.text: Leonardo portrays the last dinner Jesus had with his disciples before he was crucified.
cues.en: Leonardo portrays the last dinner Jesus had with his disciples before he was crucified.
cues.zh: 列奧納多描繪了耶穌被釘十字架前與門徒共進的最後一頓晚餐。

cues.text: The composition is dreamy.
cues.en: The composition is dreamy.
cues.zh: 構圖很夢幻。

cues.text: Leonardo captures the psychological drama as Jesus says, "One of you will betray me,"
cues.en: Leonardo captures the psychological drama as Jesus says, "One of you will betray me,"
cues.zh: 萊昂納多捕捉到了耶穌所說的心理戲劇：“你們中的一個人會背叛我”

cues.text: and the Apostles, huddling in stressed-out groups of three,
cues.en: and the Apostles, huddling in stressed-out groups of three,
cues.zh: 使徒們三人擠在一起，壓力山大，

cues.text: wonder, "Lord, is it I?" Some are scandalized,
cues.en: wonder, "Lord, is it I?" Some are scandalized,
cues.zh: 疑惑：「主啊，是我嗎？」有些人感到憤慨，

cues.text: others want more information.
cues.en: others want more information.
cues.zh: 其他人想要更多資訊。

cues.text: In this agitated atmosphere, only Judas, clutching his 30 pieces of silver,
cues.en: In this agitated atmosphere, only Judas, clutching his 30 pieces of silver,
cues.zh: 在這躁動的氣氛中，只有猶大，手裡握著他的三十塊銀子，

cues.text: is not shocked.
cues.en: is not shocked.
cues.zh: 並不震驚。

cues.text: Leonardo employs his understanding of perspective to give the fresco added punch.
cues.en: Leonardo employs his understanding of perspective to give the fresco added punch.
cues.zh: 萊昂納多運用他對透視的理解為這幅壁畫增添了衝擊力。

cues.text: The building's lines of perspective converge right on Christ.
cues.en: The building's lines of perspective converge right on Christ.
cues.zh: 建築物的透視線正好集中在基督身上。

cues.text: The viewer doesn't understand the mathematics, but subconsciously,
cues.en: The viewer doesn't understand the mathematics, but subconsciously,
cues.zh: 觀眾不懂數學，但潛意識裡，

cues.text: it's clear to anyone enjoying this masterpiece that Jesus is the powerful center of it all.
cues.en: it's clear to anyone enjoying this masterpiece that Jesus is the powerful center of it all.
cues.zh: 任何欣賞這部傑作的人都清楚，耶穌是這一切的強大中心。

cues.text: Because of Leonardo's experimental fresco technique, deterioration began within six years of its completion.
cues.en: Because of Leonardo's experimental fresco technique, deterioration began within six years of its completion.
cues.zh: 由於列奧納多的實驗性壁畫技術，完成後六年內就開始惡化。

cues.text: The church was bombed in World War II, but -- miraculously, it seemed -- the wall
cues.en: The church was bombed in World War II, but -- miraculously, it seemed -- the wall
cues.zh: 這座教堂在第二次世界大戰中遭到轟炸，但奇蹟般的是，牆

cues.text: holding the "Last Supper" remained standing.

cues.zh: 拿著《最後的晚餐》的人仍然站著。

cues.text: A recent restoration peeled away 500 years of touch-ups,
cues.en: A recent restoration peeled away 500 years of touch-ups,
cues.zh: 最近的一次修復剝離了 500 年的修飾，

cues.text: leaving a faint yet vibrant masterpiece.
cues.en: leaving a faint yet vibrant masterpiece.
cues.zh: 留下了一幅淡淡而充滿活力的傑作。

cues.text: The room depicted in the painting seems like an architectural extension of the actual room.
cues.en: The room depicted in the painting seems like an architectural extension of the actual room.
cues.zh: 畫中描繪的房間似乎是實際房間的建築延伸。

cues.text: Leonardo even painted as if the light from the real windows hit the fresco from the side.
cues.en: Leonardo even painted as if the light from the real windows hit the fresco from the side.
cues.zh: 列奧納多甚至畫得好像真實窗戶的光線從側面照射到壁畫上一樣。

cues.text: Jesus anticipates his sacrifice -- his face is sad, all-knowing, and accepting.
cues.en: Jesus anticipates his sacrifice -- his face is sad, all-knowing, and accepting.
cues.zh: 耶穌預見了他的犧牲——他的臉是悲傷的、全知的和接受的。

cues.text: Like any big European city, Milano's public transit is first class,
cues.en: Like any big European city, Milano's public transit is first class,
cues.zh: 與任何歐洲大城市一樣，米蘭的公共交通是一流的，

cues.zh: 新舊事物共享著陳舊的軌道。

cues.en: The modern underground makes this sprawling city much easier to manage.

cues.text: when you use the metro.
cues.en: when you use the metro.
cues.zh: 當你搭乘地鐵時。

cues.text: Milan is home to possibly the world's most prestigious opera house --
cues.en: Milan is home to possibly the world's most prestigious opera house --
cues.zh: 米蘭可能是世界上最負盛名的歌劇院的所在地—

cues.text: La Scala.
cues.en: La Scala.
cues.zh: 斯卡拉歌劇院。

cues.text: While tickets are pricey and tough to get, anyone can visit the museum,
cues.en: While tickets are pricey and tough to get, anyone can visit the museum,
cues.zh: 雖然門票昂貴且很難買到，但任何人都可以參觀博物館，

cues.text: which comes with a peek at the plush theater, often getting set up for the next performance.
cues.en: which comes with a peek at the plush theater, often getting set up for the next performance.
cues.zh: 伴隨著參觀豪華劇院，通常會為下一場演出做好準備。

cues.text: Since it opened in 1778, La Scala has been committed to hosting
cues.en: Since it opened in 1778, La Scala has been committed to hosting

cues.en: the grandest of operas in all their intended glory.
cues.zh: 最偉大的歌劇，其所有的榮耀。

cues.text: The La Scala Museum collection features things that mean absolutely nothing to the MTV crowd:
cues.en: The La Scala Museum collection features things that mean absolutely nothing to the MTV crowd:
cues.zh: 斯卡拉博物館 (La Scala Museum) 的收藏對 MTV 觀眾來說毫無意義：

cues.text: Toscanini's eyeglasses, well-worn batons, Caruso's bust,
cues.en: Toscanini's eyeglasses, well-worn batons, Caruso's bust,
cues.zh: 托斯卡尼尼的眼鏡、破舊的警棍、卡魯索的半身像，

cues.text: original scores, and much more.
cues.en: original scores, and much more.
cues.zh: 原始分數等等。

cues.text: The halls are alive with memories of the great composers and musicians that made this
cues.en: The halls are alive with memories of the great composers and musicians that made this
cues.zh: 大廳裡充滿了對偉大作曲家和音樂家的回憶，他們創造了這個

cues.text: the ultimate opera scene.
cues.en: the ultimate opera scene.
cues.zh: 終極歌劇場景。

cues.text: For over two centuries, Milan's glitterati has enjoyed breathtaking performances
cues.en: For over two centuries, Milan's glitterati has enjoyed breathtaking performances
cues.zh: 兩個多世紀以來，米蘭的名流們一直欣賞著令人驚嘆的表演

cues.text: by the biggest names in opera, from Maria Callas all the way back to Verdi.
cues.en: by the biggest names in opera, from Maria Callas all the way back to Verdi.
cues.zh: 歌劇界最知名的人物，從瑪麗亞·卡拉斯一直到威爾第。

cues.text: Giuseppe Verdi was the greatest of the Romantic Italian opera composers.
cues.en: Giuseppe Verdi was the greatest of the Romantic Italian opera composers.
cues.zh: 朱塞佩·威爾第是義大利最偉大的浪漫主義歌劇作曲家。

cues.text: And in the 19th century, his name meant more than music.
cues.en: And in the 19th century, his name meant more than music.
cues.zh: 在 19 世紀，他的名字不僅僅意味著音樂。

cues.text: He was a champion of the Italian unification movement.
cues.en: He was a champion of the Italian unification movement.
cues.zh: 他是義大利統一運動的擁護者。

cues.text: Back when flying an Italian flag could get you in trouble, Verdi's arias served as virtual national anthems.
cues.en: Back when flying an Italian flag could get you in trouble, Verdi's arias served as virtual national anthems.
cues.zh: 當懸掛義大利國旗可能會給你帶來麻煩時，威爾第的詠嘆調幾乎成了國歌。

cues.text: The nearby Risorgimento Museum tells the story of Italy's unification.
cues.en: The nearby Risorgimento Museum tells the story of Italy's unification.
cues.zh: 附近的復興博物館講述了義大利統一的故事。

cues.text: It helps us imagine the excitement in Europe during the mid-1800s
cues.en: It helps us imagine the excitement in Europe during the mid-1800s
cues.zh: 它幫助我們想像 1800 年代中期歐洲的熱鬧景象

cues.text: as the modern nations of Italy, Germany, and others were being born.
cues.en: as the modern nations of Italy, Germany, and others were being born.
cues.zh: 義大利、德國等現代國家正在誕生。

cues.text: Back then, a few royal families -- such as the Habsburgs, Bourbons, and Romanovs --
cues.en: Back then, a few royal families -- such as the Habsburgs, Bourbons, and Romanovs --
cues.zh: 當時，一些王室家族——比如哈布斯堡王朝、波旁王朝和羅曼諾夫王朝——

cues.text: ruled Europe without regard to nationality.
cues.en: ruled Europe without regard to nationality.
cues.zh: 統治歐洲不分國籍。

cues.text: And none of them wanted to see the emergence of modern nation states.
cues.en: And none of them wanted to see the emergence of modern nation states.
cues.zh: 他們都不想看到現代民族國家的出現。

cues.text: Even without really understanding the details, just pondering the stirring paintings here
cues.en: Even without really understanding the details, just pondering the stirring paintings here
cues.zh: 即使沒有真正瞭解細節，只是沉思這裡激動人心的畫作

cues.text: makes it clear there are Italian equivalents to our battles of Bunker Hill, Valley Forge, and Yorktown.
cues.en: makes it clear there are Italian equivalents to our battles of Bunker Hill, Valley Forge, and Yorktown.
cues.zh: 清楚地表明，義大利的邦克山、福吉谷和約克鎮之戰也有類似的情況。

cues.text: After four centuries of foreign rule, Milan helped spearhead Italy's road to unity.
cues.en: After four centuries of foreign rule, Milan helped spearhead Italy's road to unity.
cues.zh: 經過四個世紀的外國統治後，米蘭幫助義大利走上了統一之路。

cues.text: Step by step -- whether in bloody battle or by popular vote, as was the case in Venice --
cues.en: Step by step -- whether in bloody battle or by popular vote, as was the case in Venice --
cues.zh: 一步一步——無論是透過血腥的戰鬥還是透過民眾投票，就像威尼斯的情況一樣——

cues.text: Italy went from a peninsula of colonies and small states in 1850
cues.en: Italy went from a peninsula of colonies and small states in 1850
cues.zh: 1850 年，義大利從一個由殖民地和小國組成的半島

cues.text: to one united country in 1870.
cues.en: to one united country in 1870.
cues.zh: 1870 年統一為一個國家。

cues.text: Italy's heroic struggles were led by patriots whose names are household words today.
cues.en: Italy's heroic struggles were led by patriots whose names are household words today.
cues.zh: 義大利的英勇鬥爭是由愛國者領導的，他們的名字如今家喻戶曉。

cues.text: Mazzini -- the intellectual who spread the notion that Italian-speaking people should be one nation.
cues.en: Mazzini -- the intellectual who spread the notion that Italian-speaking people should be one nation.
cues.zh: 馬志尼－一位傳播義大利語人民應該成為一個民族這一觀唸的知識分子。

cues.text: Garibaldi -- the guerilla war hero whose feisty little army of red shirts
cues.en: Garibaldi -- the guerilla war hero whose feisty little army of red shirts
cues.zh: 加里波底－遊擊戰爭英雄，他的紅衫小軍充滿活力

cues.text: brought Sicily and Southern Italy into the fold.
cues.en: brought Sicily and Southern Italy into the fold.
cues.zh: 將西西里島和義大利南部納入其中。

cues.text: And Victor Emmanuel -- the only Italian-blooded king,
cues.en: And Victor Emmanuel -- the only Italian-blooded king,
cues.zh: 還有維克多·伊曼紐爾——唯一有義大利血統的國王，

cues.text: who, upon unification, was the slam-dunk favorite to be the first constitutional monarch of the new Italy.
cues.en: who, upon unification, was the slam-dunk favorite to be the first constitutional monarch of the new Italy.
cues.zh: 統一後，他成為新義大利第一位立憲君主的熱門人選。

cues.text: Throughout Italy, the George Washingtons and Thomas Jeffersons of the Italian independence movement are celebrated.
cues.en: Throughout Italy, the George Washingtons and Thomas Jeffersons of the Italian independence movement are celebrated.
cues.zh: 在整個義大利，人們慶祝義大利獨立運動的喬治華盛頓和託馬斯傑斐遜。

cues.text: Statues, streets, and squares are named in honor of the founding fathers of modern Italy.
cues.en: Statues, streets, and squares are named in honor of the founding fathers of modern Italy.
cues.zh: 雕像、街道和廣場都是為了紀念現代義大利的創始人而命名的。

cues.text: But to be honest, most Milanese seem oblivious to all this history.
cues.en: But to be honest, most Milanese seem oblivious to all this history.
cues.zh: 但說實話，大多數米蘭人似乎都忘了這一切歷史。

cues.text: They just enjoy being who they are.
cues.en: They just enjoy being who they are.
cues.zh: 他們只是喜歡做自己。

cues.text: The special Italian love of life is easy to feel in Milan's many fine parks,
cues.en: The special Italian love of life is easy to feel in Milan's many fine parks,
cues.zh: 在米蘭眾多精美的公園裡，很容易感受到義大利人對生活的特殊熱愛，

cues.text: and in a scene like this, the traveler can glimpse yet another dimension
cues.en: and in a scene like this, the traveler can glimpse yet another dimension
cues.zh: 在這樣的場景中，旅行者可以看到另一個維度

cues.text: of this city: its people at play.
cues.en: of this city: its people at play.
cues.zh: 這座城市：人們在玩耍。

cues.text: Another favorite place for the Milanese is an hour away by train.
cues.en: Another favorite place for the Milanese is an hour away by train.
cues.zh: 米蘭人最喜歡的另一個地方是搭火車一小時即可到達。

cues.text: Lombardy's seductively beautiful Lakes district, where Italy meets the Alps,
cues.en: Lombardy's seductively beautiful Lakes district, where Italy meets the Alps,
cues.zh: 倫巴第美麗迷人的湖區，義大利與阿爾卑斯山的交會處，

cues.text: seems heaven-sent for communing with nature.
cues.en: seems heaven-sent for communing with nature.
cues.zh: 與大自然交流似乎是天賜之物。

cues.text: In this land of so many popular lakes, the million-Euro question is -- which one?
cues.en: In this land of so many popular lakes, the million-Euro question is -- which one?
cues.zh: 在這片擁有眾多熱門湖泊的土地上，價值百萬歐元的問題是──哪一個？

cues.text: While all the lakes have their charms, Lake Como is my favorite.
cues.en: While all the lakes have their charms, Lake Como is my favorite.
cues.zh: 雖然所有的湖泊都有其魅力，但科莫湖是我的最愛。

cues.text: It offers the best mix of accessibility, scenery, and offbeat-ness
cues.en: It offers the best mix of accessibility, scenery, and offbeat-ness
cues.zh: 它提供了便利性、風景和另類風格的最佳組合

cues.text: with a heady whiff of aristocratic-old-days romance.
cues.en: with a heady whiff of aristocratic-old-days romance.
cues.zh: 帶著令人陶醉的舊時貴族浪漫氣息。

cues.text: Lake Como is lined with elegant 19th-century villas,
cues.en: Lake Como is lined with elegant 19th-century villas,
cues.zh: 科莫湖兩旁都是優雅的19世紀別墅，

cues.text: crowned by snowcapped mountains and busy with fleets of little ferries.
cues.en: crowned by snowcapped mountains and busy with fleets of little ferries.
cues.zh: 山頂有白雪皚皚的山脈，還有繁忙的小渡輪隊。

cues.text: It's a good place to take a break from the intensity of urban turnstile sightseeing.
cues.en: It's a good place to take a break from the intensity of urban turnstile sightseeing.
cues.zh: 這是一個遠離城市十字轉門觀光的緊張氛圍的好地方。

cues.text: It seems half the travelers you'll meet have tossed their itineraries into the lake
cues.en: It seems half the travelers you'll meet have tossed their itineraries into the lake
cues.zh: 您遇到的旅行者中似乎有一半都將行程單扔進了湖裡

cues.text: and are actually relaxing.
cues.en: and are actually relaxing.
cues.zh: 並且實際上很放鬆。

cues.text: Today the hazy, lazy lake's only serious industry
cues.en: Today the hazy, lazy lake's only serious industry
cues.zh: 如今，這個朦朧、懶惰的湖是唯一嚴肅的產業

cues.text: is tourism.
cues.en: is tourism.
cues.zh: 是旅遊業。

cues.text: Lake Como's isolation and flat economy have left it pretty much the way
cues.en: Lake Como's isolation and flat economy have left it pretty much the way
cues.zh: 科莫湖的偏僻和經濟平淡使其幾乎陷入困境

cues.text: 19th-century Romantic poets first described it.
cues.en: 19th-century Romantic poets first described it.
cues.zh: 19世紀的浪漫主義詩人首先描述了它。

cues.text: Bellagio, the self-proclaimed "pearl of the lake," is a classy combination
cues.en: Bellagio, the self-proclaimed "pearl of the lake," is a classy combination
cues.zh: 自稱為「湖中明珠」的貝拉吉歐 (Bellagio) 是一個優雅的組合

cues.text: of old-world elegance and new-world luxury.
cues.en: of old-world elegance and new-world luxury.
cues.zh: 舊世界的優雅和新世界的奢華。

cues.text: Spendy five-star hotels give the well-heeled traveler all the comforts they're accustomed to.
cues.en: Spendy five-star hotels give the well-heeled traveler all the comforts they're accustomed to.
cues.zh: 豪華的五星級飯店為富有的旅客提供了他們所習慣的所有舒適設施。

cues.text: Harborfront shops entice posh travelers with jewelry and accessories.
cues.en: Harborfront shops entice posh travelers with jewelry and accessories.
cues.zh: 海濱商店以珠寶和配件吸引時尚旅行者。

cues.text: The heavy curtains between the arcades keep the visitors and their poodles from sweating.
cues.en: The heavy curtains between the arcades keep the visitors and their poodles from sweating.
cues.zh: 拱廊之間厚重的窗簾可以防止遊客和他們的貴賓犬出汗。

cues.text: The steep lanes rising from the harbor front lead to a tangle of sun-splashed squares.
cues.en: The steep lanes rising from the harbor front lead to a tangle of sun-splashed squares.
cues.zh: 從港口前線延伸出來的陡峭小巷通往陽光普照的廣場。

cues.text: Part of the fun of your lake visit is town-hopping on the ferries.
cues.en: Part of the fun of your lake visit is town-hopping on the ferries.
cues.zh: 遊覽湖泊的樂趣之一就是乘坐渡輪遊覽城鎮。

cues.text: For me, the ideal home base for Lago di Como is 15 minutes from Bellagio -- Varenna.
cues.en: For me, the ideal home base for Lago di Como is 15 minutes from Bellagio -- Varenna.
cues.zh: 對我來說，科莫湖的理想大本營是距離貝拉焦 - 瓦倫納 15 分鐘路程。

cues.text: This town of 800 people offers the best of all lake worlds.
cues.en: This town of 800 people offers the best of all lake worlds.
cues.zh: 這個擁有 800 人的小鎮擁有世界上最好的湖泊。

cues.text: Easily accessible by train from Milan, yet on the less-developed side of the lake,
cues.en: Easily accessible by train from Milan, yet on the less-developed side of the lake,
cues.zh: 從米蘭搭乘火車即可輕鬆抵達，但位於湖的欠發達一側，

cues.text: Varenna has a romantic promenade...
cues.en: Varenna has a romantic promenade...
cues.zh: 瓦倫納有個浪漫的海濱長廊.....

cues.text: a tiny harbor...
cues.en: a tiny harbor...
cues.zh: 一個小港口...

cues.text: and narrow lanes.
cues.en: and narrow lanes.
cues.zh: 和狹窄的車道。

cues.text: These buildings are stringently protected.
cues.en: These buildings are stringently protected.
cues.zh: 這些建築物受到嚴格保護。

cues.text: You can't even change the color of your home without asking permission.
cues.en: You can't even change the color of your home without asking permission.
cues.zh: 未經許可，你甚至不能改變你家的顏色。

cues.text: There are no streets in the Old Town, just characteristic stepped lanes.
cues.en: There are no streets in the Old Town, just characteristic stepped lanes.
cues.zh: 舊城區沒有街道，只有特色的階梯巷。

cues.text: It's an ideal place to savor a lakeside cappuccino or aperitivo.
cues.en: It's an ideal place to savor a lakeside cappuccino or aperitivo.
cues.zh: 這裡是品嚐湖畔卡布奇諾或開胃酒的理想場所。

cues.text: Imagine this sleepy harbor 200 years ago.
cues.en: Imagine this sleepy harbor 200 years ago.
cues.zh: 想像一下 200 年前這個沉睡的港口。

cues.text: It was busy.
cues.en: It was busy.
cues.zh: 很忙。

cues.text: There were coopers crafting oaken chestnut into barrels, stoneworkers carving and shipping
cues.en: There were coopers crafting oaken chestnut into barrels, stoneworkers carving and shipping
cues.zh: 有制桶工人將橡木栗子製作成桶，石匠進行雕刻和運輸

cues.text: Varenna's prized black marble, and fishing boats dragged up onto this cobbled beach.
cues.en: Varenna's prized black marble, and fishing boats dragged up onto this cobbled beach.
cues.zh: 瓦倫納珍貴的黑色大理石和漁船拖到了這片鵝卵石海灘上。

cues.text: Many Lake Como towns have a villa or two, with their dilapidated 19th-century elegance,
cues.en: Many Lake Como towns have a villa or two, with their dilapidated 19th-century elegance,
cues.zh: 許多科莫湖小鎮都擁有一兩棟別墅，帶著破舊的 19 世紀優雅，

cues.text: and wistful gardens open to the public, and even transformed into inviting hotels.
cues.en: and wistful gardens open to the public, and even transformed into inviting hotels.
cues.zh: 向公眾開放的令人嚮往的花園，甚至改造成誘人的酒店。

cues.text: In Varenna, the sprawling lakeside Villa Cipressi rents rooms and welcomes visitors -- for a small fee --
cues.en: In Varenna, the sprawling lakeside Villa Cipressi rents rooms and welcomes visitors -- for a small fee --
cues.zh: 在瓦倫納，龐大的湖畔 Villa Cipressi 出租房間並歡迎遊客——只需支付少量費用——

cues.text: to explore its peaceful terraced garden.
cues.en: to explore its peaceful terraced garden.
cues.zh: 探索其寧靜的露臺花園。

cues.text: Albergo Milano, located right in the Old Town, is the kind of place I like to recommend in my guidebooks.
cues.en: Albergo Milano, located right in the Old Town, is the kind of place I like to recommend in my guidebooks.
cues.zh: Albergo Milano 位於舊城區，是我喜歡在旅遊指南中推薦的地方。

cues.text: It's graciously run by Egidio and his Swiss wife, Bettina.
cues.en: It's graciously run by Egidio and his Swiss wife, Bettina.
cues.zh: 它由艾吉迪奧 (Egidio) 和他的瑞士妻子貝蒂娜 (Bettina) 慷慨地經營。

cues.text: Fusing the best of Italy with the best of Switzerland, the place manages to be both romantic and very well-run.
cues.en: Fusing the best of Italy with the best of Switzerland, the place manages to be both romantic and very well-run.
cues.zh: 這個地方融合了義大利的精華和瑞士的精華，既浪漫又管理良好。

cues.text: Most of its comfy rooms offer dreamy lake views.
cues.en: Most of its comfy rooms offer dreamy lake views.
cues.zh: 大部分舒適的客房均享有夢幻般的湖景。

cues.text: And Egidio is a fine chef.
cues.en: And Egidio is a fine chef.
cues.zh: 艾吉迪奧是一位出色的廚師。

cues.text: The limited menu changes daily, according to the season and the chef's whim.
cues.en: The limited menu changes daily, according to the season and the chef's whim.
cues.zh: 有限的選單每天都會根據季節和廚師的想法而變化。

cues.text: Varenna whispers "luna di miele" -- honeymoon.
cues.en: Varenna whispers "luna di miele" -- honeymoon.
cues.zh: 瓦倫娜低聲說著「luna di miele」－蜜月。

cues.text: And a good place to enjoy that romance is strolling along its passerella.
cues.en: And a good place to enjoy that romance is strolling along its passerella.
cues.zh: 沿著過街巷漫步是享受浪漫的好地方。

cues.text: You'll pass wisteria-drenched villas, evocative vistas, and lakeside lovers embracing the moment.
cues.en: You'll pass wisteria-drenched villas, evocative vistas, and lakeside lovers embracing the moment.
cues.zh: 您將經過紫藤覆蓋的別墅、令人回味的遠景以及擁抱這一刻的湖畔戀人。

cues.text: It's places like this where I really feel the romance of Europe.
cues.en: It's places like this where I really feel the romance of Europe.
cues.zh: 正是在這樣的地方，我才真正感受到了歐洲的浪漫。

cues.text: I hope you've enjoyed our look at Milano and Lago di Como.
cues.en: I hope you've enjoyed our look at Milano and Lago di Como.
cues.zh: 我希望您喜歡我們對米蘭和科莫湖的看法。

cues.text: I'm Rick Steves.
cues.en: I'm Rick Steves.
cues.zh: 我是瑞克·史蒂夫斯。

cues.text: Until next time, keep on travelin'.
cues.en: Until next time, keep on travelin'.
cues.zh: 直到下次，繼續旅行。

cues.text: "Ciao."
cues.en: "Ciao."
cues.zh: “再見。”
